objective: In this workspace, replace the failing stub in `julius-live-proof.js` with a working `juliusLiveProof(input)` implementation, and replace the placeholder test in `julius-live-proof.test.js` with focused coverage of the behaviour below. Both files already exist and are tracked by git — edit them in place. Edit only files inside this workspace.
requirements: Edit `julius-live-proof.js` so `juliusLiveProof(input)` is implemented. Keep the existing `module.exports = { juliusLiveProof }` export.

`juliusLiveProof(input)` must return the string `julius:` followed by `input` with leading and trailing whitespace removed and all characters lowercased. For example `juliusLiveProof('  Relay  ')` returns `julius:relay`.
`juliusLiveProof(input)` must throw an Error whose message is exactly `julius_live_proof_empty_input` when `input` is not a string, or is a string that is empty or contains only whitespace.

Edit `julius-live-proof.test.js`, replacing the placeholder case, so it uses `node:test` and `node:assert/strict` to assert the trimming-and-lowercasing behaviour AND that the empty-input case throws with that exact message.
After your edits `node --test julius-live-proof.test.js` must exit zero, with no network access and no third-party dependency.
constraints: Edit the two existing files in place. You have `Read`, `Glob`, `Grep` and `Edit`; you cannot create files or run commands, and you do not need to.
Use CommonJS (`require` / `module.exports`). There is no bundler, no TypeScript toolchain and no `node_modules` in this workspace.
Add no dependency; the sandbox that runs the test has no network access.
Do not modify `package.json` or `README.md`, and edit nothing outside this workspace.
Keep the change small: the two files named above and nothing else.

acceptanceCriteria.text: `julius-live-proof.js` no longer throws `julius_live_proof_not_implemented`; it exports a working `juliusLiveProof` function via `module.exports`.
`juliusLiveProof` returns `julius:` concatenated with the input trimmed and lowercased, so `'  Relay  '` yields exactly `julius:relay`.
`juliusLiveProof` throws an Error with the exact message `julius_live_proof_empty_input` for a non-string, an empty string, or a whitespace-only string.
`julius-live-proof.test.js` no longer contains the placeholder case, covers both the normalising case and the throwing case, and the declared test command exits zero.
